changelog: Aura AI v2.0.7 Compact Elevated Sidebar & Permanent Porcelain Theme
Compact Gemini-Style Menu: 44dp slim rows with 6dp spacing, outlined icons, and 14dp rounded cards
Expandable More Section: Clean 'More' menu item with rotating chevron revealing Plugins & extensions
Manrope SemiBold Title: Bundled true Manrope font for the 'Aura AI' header with 48dp soft elevated search
Refined Footer: Balanced layout with 48dp circular Settings gear, centered Accounts pill, and 48dp 3-dots overflow menu
Unified Soft 3D Elevation: Consistent dual-layer ambient/spot shadows and subtle borders across all cards and buttons
Permanent Porcelain Theme: Default pure light mode with Porcelain palette across the entire app
